learning: Request telemetry on completion, progress, rms_error, line_loss_events, and steering_oscillation to verify if the increased sensor size and forward sensor placement improve line detection and control anticipation. Also monitor if the wider wheel track reduces steering oscillation and line loss events. These measurements will confirm if the geometry and controller changes enhance robustness and smoothness as intended.
rationale: The increased sensor size and forward-shifted sensor positions in the geometry should improve line detection robustness and allow earlier line sensing, aiding anticipatory control. The wider wheel track enhances turning stability, reducing steering oscillations. Based on the previous race telemetry showing early line loss and steering oscillation, I reduced base speed slightly and tuned PID gains (lower kp, ki, kd) to improve control smoothness and reduce oscillations. Sensor weights remain proportional to sensor positions for effective error correction. The line loss strategy remains 'search_left' as it worked well. The observation request includes completion, progress, rms_error, line_loss_events, and steering_oscillation to verify if these geometry and controller changes improve performance and smoothness.
